claims: Transfuse red blood cells for symptomatic anemia (hemoglobin 7.6-7.7 g/dL) with ongoing monitoring of hemoglobin and hematocrit.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (piperacillin-tazobactam and vancomycin) for leukocytosis (WBC 20.6 K/uL) and suspected infection, with reassessment of cultures and clinical response.
Monitor and manage hypokalemia (potassium 3.2 mEq/L) with intravenous potassium chloride replacement and repeat basic metabolic panel.
Continue total parenteral nutrition with lipids and monitor glucose (fingerstick 178-185 mg/dL) and electrolytes.
Obtain blood cultures and repeat complete blood count to evaluate persistent leukocytosis and anemia.
Assess and manage pain (moderate to severe, pain level 6-7) with scheduled morphine and gabapentin, and reassess pain response.
Monitor coagulation status (INR 1.7, PT 18.3 sec, PTT 28.4 sec) and continue heparin prophylaxis, with repeat coagulation panel as needed.
Monitor cardiac status with telemetry and serial troponin; troponin T is 0.01 ng/mL and BNP is 1405 pg/mL.
Maintain oxygen saturation above 92% with supplemental oxygen as needed (current SpO2 92-96% on 2 L/min).
Perform daily weights and assess nutritional status (Braden nutrition score 2, weight 79.6 kg).
